scope: Fixed 13 base archives and 11 extensions. Literal census includes comments/strings. Parsed counts require a complete successful conservative SDL parse, exclude comments, and do not expand macros/includes or resolve mounts. Geometry checks use binary32 inputs and Python arithmetic, not native predicate evaluation. No map archives or mods.
